title: RelayToken
description: One active or consumed relay token.

mode.description: "random" for a random token, "static" for a token derived for peer_pub_b64, "ecdh" for a reconnect token registered so that the peer of a dropped relay session can resume it.

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64 public key of the peer that the token was derived for. Present only when mode is "static".
